status: candidate review only; excluded from all transformations
pixel_convention: Original-image pixel-edge coordinates: x right, y down, upper-left outer corner (0,0). Crops are native resolution; original x=crop x+left and original y=crop y+top. Crosshairs are visually selected approximate channel junctions, not accepted GCPs.

candidates.name: Haw-Deep river junction
candidates.decision: Candidate only: identify modern channel-center junction, then assess historical persistence. USGS places Jordan Dam 4.1 miles upstream; this junction is not the flooded Haw-New Hope junction.

candidates.name: Trent-Neuse river junction
candidates.decision: Candidate only: decide whether stylized bank apex or channel-center junction is represented. Modern Trent mouth is an estuary; do not substitute the nearby USGS gauge or New Bern town proxy.

candidates.name: Haw-New Hope junction
candidates.decision: Exclude as modern shoreline control. Original confluence inundated by Jordan Lake; needs pre-impoundment topographic mapping and historical channel assessment.

candidates.name: Yadkin-Uwharrie candidate junction
candidates.decision: Exclude pending confirmation of historical tributary label and pre-impoundment geometry. Modern junction lies at Lake Tillery; reservoir shoreline is not a historical channel control.
